property.name: fs.defaultFS
property.description: NameNode RPC endpoint. hdfs CLI, Spark and Iceberg resolve paths such as /data/raw/ecommerce against this URI.

property.name: hadoop.tmp.dir
property.description: Base for Hadoop temporary files. Default is /tmp, which Ubuntu wipes on reboot.

property.name: io.file.buffer.size
property.description: 128 KB read/write buffer (default 4 KB) for large sequential files.

property.name: fs.trash.interval
property.description: Minutes a file deleted with "hdfs dfs -rm" stays in .Trash. Protects the raw zone from accidental deletes. Use -skipTrash to free disk at once.
